start: Settings, Backup and restore, card 'Bring back a Google Drive backup', Drive not linked, an old backup on Drive

user_sees: 'Bring back a Google Drive backup'
'Backed up to Google Drive with an older version of MettleUp? Choose the same Google account to find that backup and bring it to this phone.'
The 18+ and terms box above the button
must_not: Google's sign-in opening before the box is ticked

steps.action: Tick the box, tap 'Find my Drive backup', pick the Google account
user_sees: Button shows 'Working…'
must_not: A second search started by a second tap

user_sees: Title 'Bring back your Drive backup?'
'This replaces what’s on this phone with your backup: <summary>.' with how many workouts on this phone it removes
Button 'Bring it back'
must_not: The phone's data replaced before 'Bring it back' is tapped

user_sees: 'Your workouts are back on this phone. To keep them safe from now on, sign in on the “Backup and restore” page.'
'Undo the last restore'
must_not: Newer workouts on the MettleUp server overwritten by the older backup

start: Welcome screen on a new phone, an old backup on Drive

steps.action: Tick the box and tap 'Continue with Google'
user_sees: 'Checking your Google Drive for a backup…'
must_not: A Drive folder made when none exists

steps.action: Read the found line and tap 'Restore my backup'
user_sees: 'We found your backup from <day> with <n> workouts.'-style line
'Bringing back your backup…'
must_not: Other welcome buttons working while the restore runs

user_sees: The app opens on the restored history
must_not: The 3 setup questions asked when the backup holds a profile

start: Card 'Bring back a Google Drive backup', a Google account with no MettleUp backup

steps.action: Tap 'Find my Drive backup' and pick that account
user_sees: 'There’s no MettleUp backup in this Google account. Try “Unlink Google Drive”, then another account.'
Button 'Unlink Google Drive'
must_not: Any data on the phone changed

user_sees: 'Finish your workout first: finish or discard the workout in progress, then restore.'

start: Drive linked earlier; Google's permission has since expired or was removed (Drive answers 401 or 403)

user_sees: Today: 'Google Drive needs you to sign in again. Tap Unlink Google, then Link Google Drive.'
must_not: Words naming buttons the card does not have (the card has 'Unlink Google Drive' and 'Find my Drive backup')
Any data on the phone changed

user_sees: Title 'Undo the restore?'
'This puts back what was on this phone before the last restore.' plus how many newer workouts would be lost
must_not: The undo running without the question

user_sees: 'Done. This phone is back to how it was before the restore.'
must_not: Workouts from before the restore missing

user_sees: 'There’s nothing to undo.'

start: Card 'Bring back a Google Drive backup'

steps.action: Link a Google account and restore
user_sees: 'Looking in the Google Drive of <email>. Bring your old backup to this phone.'
must_not: Drive used for anything but finding and bringing back the backup
Files in Drive this app did not make being read
The gym seeing the restored data
